instruction: What determines the amount of leave part-time employees receive?
input: Full-time employees receive 26 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays. Part-time employees receive leave pro rata to their contracted hours.
output: Part-time employees receive leave pro rata to their contracted hours, meaning the amount of leave they receive is calculated based on the proportion of their working hours compared to full-time employees, as mentioned in the source text.

instruction: Can secondary caregivers take their leave at any time within the 12 months, or are there specific time frames mentioned?

instruction: Is additional leave granted automatically, or can it be at the manager's discretion?
